notes.title: Update Notes for V0.4.6 and updates
notes.content:
Hey guys! Sorry for the wait on world 4 :(
It's been busy recently and the update is taking longer than I expected but I wanted to give a small update of showing some love to characters that I feel aren't as strong as the others.

V0.4.6
Bear Girl: every 3 attacks, deal bonus damage based on missing health
Arien: shoots 2 arrows instead of 3 now
Patra: On crit, fills bar faster
Lawrence: base crit 20% -> 25%
Cordelia: On crit, fills bar faster
Reina: heal slight amount on hit and gain attack damage bonus when at full health
Ash: bigger aoe on attacks/ buffed skill chance/ changed stack activation from 5 -> 3

Thanks so much everyone for being patient with me and I hope to see y'all again soon!
Keen :)

notes.title: Update Notes for v0.4.5
notes.content:
Hi everyone! New character time! Woohoooooo. With this update, Kipi has moved out of the rate up banner and now we have Elven Sorceress Cordelia as the current rate-up hero. Let me know what y'all think of her :) I also did a lot of balancing with stat choices as well as Hero balancing. 

v0.4.5
- Added Elven Sorceress Cordelia to new Hero Banner
- Added "Inventory Full" Notification
- Increased Blue Mushroom speed
- Blue Mushroom health 200 -> 175
- Base Red Mushroom health 200 -> 150
- Green Mushroom health 300 -> 225
- Desert Cobra Attack: 50 -> 35
- Desert Cobra Max Health: 400 -> 350
- Adjusted Desert World room 6 for a better player experience
- Adjusted Desert World room 8 for a better player experience

Stat balancing
- Common Attack Damage upgrade: 5-> 2
- Rare Attack Damage upgrade: 10-> 4
- Super Rare Attack Damage upgrade: 15 -> 6
- Common Attack Speed upgrade: 0.03 -> 0.05
- Common Crit Rate upgrade: 3% -> 5%
- Common Max Health upgrade: 20 -> 10
- Rare Max Health upgrade: 50 -> 20
- Super Rare Max Health upgrade: 100 -> 30

Hero Balancing
- Arien Crit Rate: 12% -> 10%
- Bear Girl Base Health: 100 -> 120
- Bear Girl Attack Damage: 20 -> 25
- Jin Attack Damage: 10 -> 25
- Increased Jin dash range on attacks
- Jin Slows down less on attack
- Added splash damage to all of Ash's attacks
- Ash Base Attack Damage: 10 -> 13

Bug Fixes:
- Rate up pity no longer resets on super rare pull but on the rate up character pull
- Fixed Guild Sell Screen Sell Button being funky
- Other various bug fixes

Thanks everyone for the support as always. If you haven't joined the community discord yet, this is the link https://discord.gg/MvFzpFcUsM

See y'all next time,
Keen

notes.title: Update v0.4.3
notes.content:
Small update to fix some issues and increase QoL

v0.4.3
Bug Fixes
- Game crash after room 20 clear
- Adjusted Verna's text in world 3
- Added background for Verna dialogue
- Audio setting saving in main menu but not settings screen in game
- Adjusted Patra for qol when placing scarabs
- Fixed possible sound glitches
- Added slight windows before ranged enemies attack
- Locked skins now say "locked"
- Goblin arrow can no longer hurt player when it hits an enemy
- Kipi attacking (kipi atkspd cap at 1.75 and slwoed down scaling)
- General fixes

Nerfs:
Kipi: Kipi was broken in more ways than 1 I realized so she has been nerfed and fixed.
- Attack Speed cap of 1.75
- Attack Speed scaling 0.005 => 0.002

Thanks everyone, 
Keen

notes.title: Early Access release and v0.4.2
notes.content:
Hi everyone :)
I'm Keen, the developer of Journey of Seasons: Heroes. I'm super excited for JOS:H to be released for early access wooooo.
This is a rather large update, but I guess if this is your first time playing it, you wouldn't have known anything before this.
I'm really excited to add more content so I hope you stick around as my game continues to grow :)

V0.4.2
bug fixes:
- Fixed Bear Girl being unable to crit
- Fixed boulder boy being able to hurt the player from contact when not rolling
- Fixed luck Soul Stone upgrade tooltip to display correct information
- Fixed issue where defeating Gob-bomb as final boss does not count as dungeon win to unlock next world
- Fixed issue where Really Big Goblin Dude would damage the player if they were in melee range during a ranged attack
- Fixed issue where Really Big Giblin Dude could damage the player after it was slain
- Fixed boulder boy animations to be easier to read when attacking
- Fixed time formatting and calculation on dead run
- Fixed Reina's enpowered projectile damage
- Fixed Arien's projectile being able to hit multiple enemies with one arrow
- Closed the world barrier in base camp so that the player cant escape >:)
- Fixed Sphynx Girl Earrings being worth 0 crystals
- Fixed bug where after exiting a run, if the player were to attack, the player would gain the speed bonuses gained through the run
- Fixed bug where White Mushroom Queen would constantly spawn minions and stay invicible as long as she had minions
- Fixed Reina's on hit sound
- Fixed Green Mushroom's projectile being able to go through player
- General bug fixes

Changes:
- Added a wardrobe function to change skins
- Added some on boarding to help the player become familiar with the game faster
- Added information tooltips to Heroes' House, Wishing Pond, Soul Ring Stone, Verna's Guild Stand, and World Teleporter.
- Changed cameras in dungeon to be either locked, or following the player in boss rooms
- Added several spots where the game will force save (no resetting for gacha pulls sorry)
- Added a indicator to help spot drops
- Added a flash to the player's health bar when player is damaged
- Added transitions inbetween scenes
- Added little icons on the main screen to show hero slots
- Adjusted and changed formatting of run timer
- Removed 2 obstacles that the player could get stuck on in World 1
- Added jingle when rooms are cleared
- Added portal spawning animation when room is cleared
- Fixed healing after a miniboss battle (Sorry)
- Changed Bear Girl party stat to be for luck rather than health since it was causing issues
- Made Gob-bomb shoot less frequently but faster
- Filled in some more tilemap that didn't have any tetxures in Base Camp
- Adjusted ordering of UI elements
- Added % after Crit rate and crit dmg on screens showing stats
- Added a 1 before attackspeed on screens showing stats
- Rounded some stat numbers up to avoid floating point numbers
- Added descriptions to each character at the Heroes' Home
- Added an indicator to Jin's attacks
- Added an indicator so that the player knows when Patra is ready to make a scarab
- Added more tiles to caveworld
- General quality of life changes

Make sure to join the discord if you haven't already to report bugs and give me suggestions or feedback :)
https://discord.gg/MvFzpFcUsM

Thanks for the support everyone and see you next update,
Keen
